# Office Software Marketplace

> Independent reviews of office, finance, HR and IT software for small and mid-sized teams. 226 full reviews live here as the canonical version, 94 of them tested hands-on by us (listed below with the date and what we measured); prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-11-27.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

## Best evidence first: our strongest hands-on reviews
- [Top Echelon](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/top-echelon-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-31. Best for Small recruiting agencies working split placements; from $79 · TE Recruit Standard · per seat per month billed annually · read 2026-11-23; our finding: Almost everything people shop for sits in Professional, not Standard: Smart-TE AI, automations, sequences, inbound email sync and API access are all one tier up, so…
- [xTiles](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/xtiles-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-21. Best for Individuals who plan their day in one place; from $19 · Plus, per user · per user per month billed monthly · read 2026-11-22; our finding: The free plan keeps only the current and the previous week of planner history open (the pricing page says two weeks; in our test on 21 October 2026 everything older was greyed…
- [Assembly](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/assembly-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-24. Best for Agencies with up to 500 active clients; from $29 · a month, billed annually ($49 billed monthly) · read 2026-09-28; our finding: Active contacts bite first: Starter stops at 50, and the step to 500 costs $70 more a month on yearly billing ($90 monthly).
- [Emergent](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/emergent-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-09-26. Best for Founders prototyping an app idea without developers; from $20 · per month ($17 yearly) for 100 credits · read 2026-10-17; our finding: Now do the division, because Emergent's own pricing page doesn't.
- [Blinq](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/blinq-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-23. Best for Freelancers and individuals who network often; from $9.99 · Premium, for individuals · billed monthly · read 2026-11-24; our finding: And a truth about all digital cards: the wow factor works precisely because adoption is still low; the durable value is the CRM sync (contacts flowing automatically into your…
- [BookX](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/bookx-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-11-17. Best for Shopify rental and tour businesses; from $4.99 · Starter · a month, or $49.99 a year, for five locations and team members · read 2026-11-02; not for studios and gyms not selling on Shopify; our finding: The free plan is a demonstration rather than a plan.
- [Dext](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/dext-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-21. Best for Accountants and bookkeepers collecting client receipts; from $25.21 · per month billed annually ($31.50 billed monthly) · read 2026-10-10; not for sole traders with only a few receipts; our finding: Dext is a data-capture layer, not accounting software: it feeds Xero, QuickBooks or Sage, so you still need one of those.
- [Leavo](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/leavo-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-31. Best for Teams of 10 to 50 tracking overtime; from $2.50 · per user a month billed yearly · read 2026-10-19; not for tiny teams that just need hours logged; our finding: The tidy per-user numbers are annual-billed, and it's priced per seat: every employee you track adds to the bill, with no volume break published (large…
- [Planday](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/planday-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-10-31. Best for Restaurants and shops with 10 or more shift staff; from €2.99 · Starter · per user per month with a 5-user minimum, so the real floor is EUR 14.95 · read 2026-10-05; our finding: The €25 monthly platform fee on Plus is the line most comparisons miss.
- [Descript](https://officesoftwaremarketplace.com/descript-review.html): tested hands-on 2026-09-30. Best for Podcasters editing one show a week; from $16 · per person a month billed annually, $24 billed monthly · read 2026-11-16; our finding: Descript is per-editor pricing with two meters running underneath: media hours AND monthly AI credits.
